primitives.name: Market Foundation Layer
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Core Sports & Market Domain (`GSE`) - **Market Foundation Layer (Layer 1)**: The consensus closing or live market line treated as the baseline prior before situational reasoning is applied.
primitives.assumptions: Baseline market line is representative of true implied probability without situational bias.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When external factors exceed model sensitivity thresholds.

layer2.mapping: Layer 1 provides initial probability distribution; Layer 2 adjusts via contextual variables.

primitives.name: Situational Overlay
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Situational Overlay (Layer 2)**: The structured contextual adjustment derived from coaching tendencies, trench pressure disruption, active injury availability, weather physics, and rest/travel differentials.
primitives.assumptions: Contextual variables are independently informative and additive.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When variable correlations exceed linear independence assumptions.

layer2.mapping: Layer 2 modifies Layer 1 using exogenous environmental and behavioral inputs.
layer2.telemetry: Deviation from baseline probability after overlay application.

primitives.name: De-Vigged Fair Probability
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **De-Vigged Fair Probability**: The bookmaker-margin-removed implied probability of a market outcome computed via Shin closed-form or multiplicative power de-vigging.
primitives.assumptions: Bookmaker margin follows standard deviation-based structure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When margin structure deviates from assumed functional form.

layer2.mapping: Maps raw market odds to theoretically fair probability space.
layer2.telemetry: Accuracy of de-vigged probability vs actual outcome frequency.

primitives.name: Conjunction Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Conjunction Gate (Stage 5 Gate)**: The final decision boundary requiring calibrated probability, positive expected value against the de-vigged market, source agreement, and conformal interval clearance before a play is eligible for publication.
primitives.assumptions: All criteria must be jointly satisfied for eligibility.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When any single criterion fails to meet threshold.

layer2.mapping: Enforces probabilistic consistency and validation across all GSE layers.
layer2.telemetry: Proportion of plays passing gate per game slate.

reasoning_traces.think:
Market Foundation Layer (L1) establishes a baseline probability distribution from consensus lines. Situational Overlay (L2) introduces adjustments based on real-time contextual signals such as injuries, weather, and coaching behavior. De-Vigged Fair Probability removes bookmaker margins to reveal true implied odds. Conjunction Gate acts as a probabilistic filter ensuring only high-confidence outcomes proceed to publication. These primitives form a layered reasoning pipeline where each stage refines the previous one, culminating in a calibrated decision boundary. Failure modes include overfitting in L2, incorrect margin removal in L3, or insufficient validation at L4. The system's robustness depends on maintaining statistical independence between layers and verifying empirical alignment with observed outcomes.
